title: The Team Name That Fits Two
youtube_title: The Team Name That Fits Two | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Friendship makes room before it keeps score.
summary: At a schoolyard with a low swing and a circle of stones, Walid is just outside the fun, close to a team name that was not only your own name. Niko changes the seating, the rules, or the pace so Walid has a real place, not a prize announced out loud. Cousin Pio lets the children solve it.
